ayahs.2: Yeh hikmat wali kitaab ki aayaten hain.
ayahs.3: Jo neko-kaaron ke liye rehbar aur (sarasar) rahmat hai.
ayahs.4: Jo log namaz qaaim karte hain aur zakaat ada karte hain aur aakhirat par (kaamil) yaqeen rakhte hain.
ayahs.5: Yehi log hain jo apne Rabb ki taraf se hidayat par hain aur yehi log najaat paane wale hain.
ayahs.6: Aur baaz log aise bhi hain jo laghv baaton ko mol lete hain ke be-ilmi ke saath logon ko Allah ki raah se behkaayen aur ise hansi banaayen, yehi woh log hain jin ke liye ruswa karne wala azaab hai.
ayahs.7: Jab is ke saamne hamari aayaten tilaawat ki jaati hain to takabbur karta hua is tarah munh pher leta hai goya us ne suna hi nahin goya ke us ke donon kaanon mein daat lage hue hain, aap ise dardnaak azaab ki khabar suna dijiye.
ayahs.8: Beshak jin logon ne imaan qubool kiya aur kaam bhi nek (mutaabiq-e-sunnat) kiye un ke liye ne'maton wali jannaten hain.
ayahs.9: Jahan woh hamesha rahenge. Allah ka sachcha wada hai, woh bahut badi izzat-o-ghalba wala aur kaamil hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.10: Isi ne aasmanon ko baghair sutoon ke paida kiya hai tum unhein dekh rahe ho aur us ne zameen mein pahaadon ko daal diya taake woh tumhein junbish na de sake aur har tarah ke jaandaar zameen mein phaila diye. Aur hum ne aasman se paani barsa kar zameen mein har qism ke nafees jode uga diye.
ayahs.11: Yeh hai Allah ki makhlooq ab tum mujhe is ke siwa doosre kisi ki koi makhlooq to dikhaao (kuchh nahin), balke yeh zaalim khuli gumraahi mein hain.
ayahs.12: Aur hum ne yaqeenan Luqman ko hikmat di thi ke tu Allah Taala ka shukr kar har shukr karne wala apne hi nafa ke liye shukr karta hai jo bhi na-shukri kare woh jaan le ke Allah Taala be-niyaaz aur tareefon wala hai.
ayahs.13: Aur jabke Luqman ne waaz kehte hue apne ladke se farmaaya ke mere pyaare bachche! Allah ke saath shareek na karna beshak shirk bada bhaari zulm hai.
ayahs.14: Hum ne insan ko us ke maan baap ke mutaalliq naseehat ki hai, us ki maan ne dukh par dukh utha kar use hamal mein rakha aur us ki doodh chhudaai do baras mein hai ke tu meri aur apne maan baap ki shukr-guzaari kar, (tum sab ko) meri hi taraf laut kar aana hai.
ayahs.15: Aur agar woh donon tujh par is baat ka dabaao daalen ke tu mere saath shareek kare jis ka tujhe ilm na ho to tu un ka kehna na maanna, haan dunya mein un ke saath achchhi tarah basar karna aur us ki raah chalna jo meri taraf jhuka hua ho tumhara sab ka lautna meri hi taraf hai tum jo kuchh karte ho is se phir main tumhein khabardaar karoonga.
ayahs.16: Pyaare bete! Agar koi cheez raai ke daane ke baraabar ho phir woh (bhi) khwaah kisi chattan mein ho ya aasmanon mein ho ya zameen mein ho ise Allah Taala zaroor laayega Allah Taala bada bareek-been aur khabardaar hai.
ayahs.17: Aye mere pyaare bete! Tu namaz qaaim rakhna, achchhe kaamon ki naseehat karte rehna, bure kaamon se mana kiya karna aur jo museebat tum par aa jaaye sabr karna (yaqeen maano) ke yeh bade taakeedi kaamon mein se hai.
ayahs.18: Logon ke saamne apne gaal na phula aur zameen par itra kar na chal kisi takabbur karne wale shekhi-khore ko Allah Taala pasand nahin farmaata.
ayahs.19: Apni raftaar mein miyaana-ravi ikhtiyaar kar, aur apni aawaaz past kar yaqeenan aawaazon mein sab se badtar aawaaz gadhon ki aawaaz hai.
ayahs.20: Kya tum nahin dekhte ke Allah Taala ne zameen-o-aasman ki har cheez ko hamare kaam mein laga rakha hai aur tumhein apni zaahiri-o-baatini ne'maten bharpoor de rakhi hain, baaz log Allah ke baare mein baghair ilm ke aur baghair hidayat ke aur baghair roshan kitaab ke jhagda karte hain.
ayahs.21: Aur jab un se kaha jaata hai ke Allah Taala ki utaari hui wahi ki taabedaari karo to kehte hain ke hum ne to jis tareeq par apne baap dadon ko paaya hai isi ki taabedaari karenge, agarche shaytaan un ke badon ko dozakh ke azaab ki taraf bulaata ho.
ayahs.22: Aur jo (shakhs) apne aap ko Allah ke taabe kar de aur ho bhi woh neko-kaar yaqeenan us ne mazboot kada thaam liya, tamaam kaamon ka anjaam Allah ki taraf hai.
ayahs.23: Kaafiron ke kufr se aap ranjeeda na hon, aakhir un sab ko lautna to hamari jaanib hi hai phir hum un ko bataayenge jo unhon ne kiya hai, be-shak Allah seenon ke bhedon tak se waaqif hai.
ayahs.24: Hum unhein go kuchh yunhi sa faaida de den lekin (bil-aakhir) hum unhein nihaayat bechaargi ki haalat mein sakht azaab ki taraf hanka le jaayenge.
ayahs.25: Agar aap un se daryaaft karen ke aasman-o-zameen ka Khaaliq kaun hai? To yeh zaroor jawab denge ke Allah, to keh dijiye ke sab tareefon ke laaiq Allah hi hai, lekin in mein ke aksar be-ilm hain.
ayahs.26: Aasmanon mein aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai woh sab Allah hi ka hai yaqeenan Allah Taala bahut bada be-niyaaz aur sazawaar-e-hamd-o-sana hai.
ayahs.27: Roo-e-zameen ke (tamaam) darakhton ke agar qalamain ho jaayen aur tamaam samundaron ki siyaahi ho aur un ke baad saat samundar aur hon taaham Allah ke kalimaat khatm nahin ho sakte, beshak Allah Taala ghaalib aur ba-hikmat hai.
ayahs.28: Tum sab ki paidaish aur marne ke baad jilaana aisa hi hai jaise ek jee ka, beshak Allah Taala sunne wala dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.29: Kya aap nahin dekhte ke Allah Taala raat ko din mein aur din ko raat mein khapa deta hai, sooraj chaand ko isi ne farmaanbardaar kar rakha hai har ek muqarrara waqt tak chalta rahe, Allah Taala har us cheez se jo tum karte ho khabardaar hai.
ayahs.30: Yeh sab (intizamaat) is wajah se hain ke Allah Taala haq hai aur is ke siwa jin jin ko log pukaarte hain sab baatil hain aur yaqeenan Allah Taala bahut bulandiyon wala aur badi shaan wala hai.
ayahs.31: Kya tum is par ghaur nahin karte ke darya mein kashtiyan Allah ke fazl se chal rahi hain is liye ke woh tumhein apni nishaaniyan dikhlaaye, yaqeenan is mein har ek sabr-o-shukr karne wale ke liye bahut si nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.32: Aur jab un par maujen saayebaanon ki tarah chha jaati hain to woh (nihaayat) khuloos ke saath aitiqaad kar ke Allah Taala hi ko pukaarte hain. Phir jab woh (Baari Taala) unhein najaat de kar khushki ki taraf pahunchaata hai to kuchh un mein se aitidaal par rehte hain, aur hamari aayaton ka inkaar sirf wohi karte hain jo bad-ahd aur na-shukre hon.
ayahs.33: Logo! Apne Rabb se daro aur is din ka khauf karo jis din baap apne bete ko koi nafa na pahuncha sakega aur na beta apne baap ka zara sa bhi nafa karne wala hoga (yaad rakho) Allah ka wada sachcha hai (dekho) tumhein dunya ki zindagi dhoke mein na daale aur na dhoke-baaz (shaytaan) tumhein dhoke mein daal de.
ayahs.34: Be-shak Allah Taala hi ke paas qayamat ka ilm hai wahi baarish naazil farmaata hai aur maan ke pet mein jo hai ise jaanta hai. Koi (bhi) nahin jaanta ke kal kya (kuchh) karega? Na kisi ko yeh maloom hai ke kis zameen mein marega. (Yaad rakho) Allah Taala hi poore ilm wala aur saheeh khabron wala hai.
